per_key.linguistic_reasoning: Natural impersonal connection status, not a claim that the phone is disconnected. Matches existing unreachable: No se puede contactar con el equipo propietario. The opaque name occupies the exact single {device} slot; no article or translation is imposed on it.

Mover and copiar retain the established verbs in row_long_press_hint. Infinitives are idiomatic for a destination heading, and a introduces the destination radio choices; no operation-start claim or final punctuation.

per_key.english: This app can offer the devices your sessions show. A device with no visible session cannot be picked yet — open Local Operator on the other computer and pull the list to refresh.
per_key.current_text: Esta app solo ofrece los dispositivos que aparecen en tus sesiones. Si un dispositivo no tiene ninguna sesión visible, aún no puedes seleccionarlo. Abre Local Operator en el otro equipo y desliza la lista hacia abajo para actualizarla.
per_key.linguistic_reasoning: Idiomatic tú register in tus/puedes/Abre/desliza, consistent with Comprueba/Actualiza in the existing namespace. Solo makes the documented visibility limitation explicit, not an invented restriction. dispositivos names generic destinations; equipo means the other computer. No visible session remains the selection limitation; both opening Local Operator and pulling the list downward to refresh are present.

per_key.english: It did not answer when this computer asked.
per_key.current_text: No respondió a la solicitud de este equipo.
per_key.linguistic_reasoning: Respondió a la solicitud is normal computing prose, not the literal calque preguntó. The omitted subject is the unreachable computer in the preceding status; de este equipo correctly identifies the requesting relay computer, not the phone. Source branch retains nonblank server reasons verbatim; this sentence is fallback only.

No hay otros dispositivos visibles is natural neutral Spanish and preserves visible, rather than asserting that other devices are offline or absent from the network. dispositivo matches the shared device glossary.

En este equipo is compact and idiomatic. equipo matches equipo propietario/conectado and este equipo in the existing remote-session namespace; it does not rename the relay computer as the phone. The unrelated existing sidebar máquina does not create new drift in this seven-key scope.
Ahora mismo is a normal temporal section heading, not an instruction to act. Sentence case and lack of final punctuation match the source and surrounding compact labels.
